[residual] Local Neo4j driver's own connection auth is inherited unchanged; a misconfig there would already affect every recall channel.
[residual] If a per-viewer authorization model were ever added to the KG, this channel like all existing ones would need to honor it; today none exists.
[residual] None within scope — introducing an access model is outside this facet's intent.
[residual] None of consequence; a read leaves no integrity-trail requirement.
[residual] A wrong Cypher could misclassify edges (false signal), but that is observation correctness not data loss; the KG is never mutated.
[residual] Behavior depends on Neo4j reachability, but graceful-empty + existing live-fixture test cover the down/empty case; no new external surface.
[residual] An oversized limit could strain the KG, but that capacity facet is carried by resource-exhaustion.
[residual] If the Cypher ever RETURNed a whole node/edge, the per-node author could leak (graphrag.py:1133-1135) — confirm the author-omitted scalar projection in review.
[residual] Committer-identity exposure has a privacy angle but that is covered by pii-leak; no regulated-domain data in scope.
[residual] Consumers benefit only after graphs re-ingested with the resolution marker, but that version-skew is carried by compat-version.
[residual] A poor hardcoded LIMIT default is a boundary/resource issue (covered there), not a configuration-loading failure.
[residual] Pre-existing timestamp projection semantics inherited; no new time arithmetic.
[close_reason] Read-only recall entry point + additive CLI/export/test; opens a Neo4j session via the pre-existing driver and runs a parameterized MATCH. Touches no authentication code path, adds no login/credential surface.
[close_reason] No authz check exists or is added; KG recall is uniformly open — all channels read the same graph with no per-node access control.
[close_reason] Detect-only code-quality signal; defines and requests no actor/permission model.
[close_reason] Read-only query performs no state-changing, auditable action; nothing to log for non-repudiation.
[close_reason] Detect-only/provider-free with no KG writes, no schema migration, no partial-write path (sibling recall_churn only reads sessions).
[close_reason] Provider-free, no 3rd-party API, no external side-effect; only external dependency is the pre-existing local Neo4j driver used by every recall channel.
[close_reason] Local advisory read-only query exposes no privileged action; a plain MATCH ... ORDER BY id LIMIT is server-bounded in compute like recall_churn (no per-seed CALL{} expansion, so no fan-out cap needed).
[close_reason] Output projects code-structure fields (id/name/path/lines/commit) via the author-omitted _item/_sources pattern; no credential or secret field is read or printed; connection secrets come from existing config.
[close_reason] Handles no regulated data domain (finance/health); flags source-code edge precision.
[close_reason] Purely additive, read-only, revertible (drop the function/subcommand); no data migration, feature flag, or phased-release coordination.
[close_reason] Introduces no new config key; limit is a function arg/CLI flag with an in-code default; driver config is pre-existing.
[close_reason] Confidence is deterministic grounding-coverage, not time-based; any committed_at/timestamp fields pass through unchanged from the existing projection with no new tz/clock computation.
